curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can Lilo accept that the friends who stayed with her may now have places of their own?
curatedMovie.description: After rounding up every genetic experiment across Earth, Stitch and his crew are offered prestigious roles in the Galactic Alliance—leaving Lilo to confront whether it is finally time to let her alien family move on.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Warm, lighthearted sci-fi comedy with a tender emotional pull, moving at an easy, family-friendly pace.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Brisk and heartfelt, this animated sci-fi comedy balances energetic extraterrestrial fun with an affectionate, bittersweet crossroads for its beloved found family.
